Do not repeat the stream-bank panorama, river on the right, opposite-bank log, mountains or framing trunks unless this specific story idea calls for them. Match the same forest world through felt texture, natural vegetation, palette and light, not background layout. Show only Milo as the animal subject. Use the attached Milo image for exact identity, compact anatomy and proportions: A small handmade needle-felt mouse matching the owner-approved r03 master: warm neutral-grey finely matted wool with soft handmade irregularities, a rounded forehead and softly continuous cheeks, cream muzzle with a small charcoal nose and closed gentle mouth crease, large moss-green irises with dark pupils and modest visible eye white, fine whiskers, two large rounded ears with dark grey felt interiors, a compact torso with a modest elongated cream chest/belly inset, short sturdy limbs and a muted burnt-orange felt tail. Scene illumination may tint the lit side while intrinsic wool colours remain consistent. Match the identity, not the canonical standing pose.
